subject: french
general_outcomes: develop the ability to use the language for purposes of practical communication
appreciate the culture of other people to promote national and international relationship for peaceful co-existence
contribute to the cognitive and affective development of the student
promote positive attitudes and develop an appreciation of the value of language.

assessment_rubric.indicator: Ability to use vocabulary and expressions to probe and engage in oral interactions
assessment_rubric.meets: The learner uses all targeted vocabulary and expressions to probe and engage in oral interactions
assessment_rubric.approaches: The learner uses some of the targeted vocabulary and expressions to probe and engage in oral interactions
assessment_rubric.below: The learner uses very few of the targeted vocabulary and expressions to probe and engage in oral interactions

assessment_rubric.indicator: Ability to maintain correct spoken language patterns (pronunciation, intonation, rhythm and pacing) in oral expression
assessment_rubric.exceeds: The learner maintains correct pronunciation, intonation, rhythm and pacing at all times in oral expression. Makes successful attempts at using colloquial and idiomatic expressions.
assessment_rubric.meets: The learner maintains correct pronunciation, intonation, rhythm and pacing at all times in oral expression. Communication is clear and fluid.
assessment_rubric.approaches: The learner maintains correct pronunciation, intonation, rhythm and pacing most of the time in oral expression. Makes a few errors at times that may interfere with communication

assessment_rubric.exceeds: The learner responds to all questions and prompts to show comprehension and engagement and goes further to give appropriate illustrations and examples.
assessment_rubric.meets: The learner responds to all questions and prompts to show comprehension and engagement
assessment_rubric.approaches: The learner responds to some questions and prompts to show comprehension and engagement
assessment_rubric.below: The learner responds to very few questions and prompts to show comprehension and engagement

assessment_rubric.indicator: Ability to employ gestures and facial expressions to enhance oral interactions
assessment_rubric.exceeds: The learner employs adequate gestures and facial expressions in oral expressions whenever required. Is sensitive to cultural diversity and adapts non-verbal cues to diverse cultural contexts.
assessment_rubric.meets: The learner employs adequate gestures and facial expressions to complement oral expressions whenever required.
assessment_rubric.approaches: The learner employs some gestures and facial expressions to complement oral expressions when required. A few gestures and facial expressions used do not rhyme with the intended communication
assessment_rubric.below: The learner employs a few gestures and facial expressions to complement oral expressions when required. Many of the gestures and facial expressions used do not rhyme with the intended communication

assessment_rubric.indicator: Ability to display willingness to participate in oral interactions
assessment_rubric.exceeds: The learner is always willing to start and/or participate in meaningful oral interactions with people in their surroundings. Encourages others to engage in oral interactions.
assessment_rubric.meets: The learner is always willing to start and/or participate in meaningful oral interactions with people in their surroundings.
assessment_rubric.approaches: The learner is at times hesitant to start and/or participate in meaningful oral interactions with people in their surroundings.
assessment_rubric.below: The learner is mostly hesitant to start and/or participate in meaningful oral interactions with people in their surroundings.

inquiry_questions: Why do you think the difference in ages of individual members of the family matters?
What makes your school unique?
Why is knowledge of months of the year important?
How do you prepare for your fun and enjoyment moments?
What roles do foods and drinks play in our day-to-day life?
Why is your body important to you?
How do you describe the weather of a particular place?
How would you ensure people do not get lost in school?
Suggested Key Inquiry Question(s)
What can make reading of greetings fun and enjoyable?
Why do think reading is important in day-to-day life?
How would you describe your school?
What do you think guides the naming of the months of the year?
What do you consider when choosing games and sports for fun and enjoyment?
What do you think can make someone like or dislikes certain foods and drinks?
How do different parts of your body help in making your life easy?
What makes weather conditions differ from one area to another?
What makes sense of direction and orientation in school possible?
Key Inquiry Question(s)
What do you think you should consider to be able to write a good text?
Why do you think families differ one from the other?
Why are school buildings labeled?
Why do you think seasonal events come at specific months of the year?
Why do people have different preferences on sports and games?
Why do you think it is important to know other people’s preferences on foods and drinks?
Why do you think weather conditions of a given place change from time to time?
